summary: This video showcases an Aura element team performance in the Crown Contest mode against the Fire Fortress Elemental Guardians. The team achieved over 4.12 billion total damage within the 5-minute fight duration, securing an S+ rank reward. The lineup consists of Talethia as the primary DPS, supported by Anneliesis, Diantha, Lincos, and Naro. Specific hero stat priorities and gear choices are shown at the end of the video, including substitution advice for players missing Naro.

tips: Build Talethia with max DPS stats (Attack, Crit Rate, Crit Damage) to maximize her damage potential.
If Naro is unavailable, substitute with another support hero like Ardreth.
Equip Lincos with the Puppeteer set for optimal performance in Aura compositions.
